name: PowerDNS-Admin
description: Web interface for managing PowerDNS zones, records, and users.

envVars.description: API key of the PowerDNS server being managed

composeOverride:
# Generated by McHarbor App Store
services:
  {{serviceName}}:
    image: {{image}}
    container_name: {{containerName}}
    restart: unless-stopped
{{ports}}
    environment:
      TZ: {{env.TZ}}
      SQLALCHEMY_DATABASE_URI: "mysql://powerdns_admin:{{env.MYSQL_PASSWORD}}@{{serviceName}}-mariadb/powerdns_admin"
      SECRET_KEY: {{env.SECRET_KEY}}
      PDNS_API_KEY: {{env.PDNS_API_KEY}}
    volumes:
      - {{appDataPath}}/data:/data
    depends_on:
      - {{serviceName}}-mariadb
  {{serviceName}}-mariadb:
    image: mariadb:11
    container_name: {{serviceName}}-mariadb
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      MYSQL_DATABASE: powerdns_admin
      MYSQL_USER: powerdns_admin
      MYSQL_PASSWORD: {{env.MYSQL_PASSWORD}}
      MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD: {{env.MYSQL_PASSWORD}}
    volumes:
      - {{appDataPath}}/mariadb:/var/lib/mysql
